title: RingCentral to Present at Goldman Sachs and Piper Sandler Conferences
body_markdown:
September 2, 2026


# RingCentral to Present at Goldman Sachs and Piper Sandler Conferences


BELMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[RingCentral, Inc.](https://www.ringcentral.com/) (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, today announced that members of its management team are scheduled to present at the following investor conferences:


**Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference 2026** Date: Thursday, September 10, 2026
Time: 1:45 p.m. PT / 4:45 p.m. ET


**Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference** Date: Tuesday, September 15, 2026
Time: 2:30 p.m. PT / 4:30 p.m. CT


A live webcast and replay of these fireside presentations will be accessible on the Company’s investor relations website at[ir.ringcentral.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fir.ringcentral.com%2F&esheet=54597733&newsitemid=20260902359206&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.ringcentral.com&index=2&md5=9cd05ffedb60fd9fd8a3ace1c91a32c0) .


**About RingCentral**


RingCentral is a global leader in AI–powered customer engagement, delivering an integrated platform for business phone, SMS, contact center, workforce engagement management, video collaboration, and messaging. Powered by advanced AI capabilities, RingCentral delivers intelligence at every phase of the conversation journey — before, during, and after each human interaction. With RingCentral, businesses can work smarter, respond faster, and connect more meaningfully with their customers. Visit ringcentral.com to learn more.
